newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says to cut 97 debt/gdp ratio by 1 pct pt.
newsitem.headline: Spain says to cut 97 debt/gdp ratio by 1 pct pt.

text.p: MADRID, May 20 - Spain will reduce its debt to gross domestic product (GDP) ratio in 1997 by more than one percentage point to around 68 percent, the Treasury director general said on Tuesday.
"The (Maastricht) debt criteria will be met with no problems this year," Jaime Caruana told reporters after a seminar in Madrid
"...debt will fall by more than one percentage point over GDP," he added.
